title: tidybreed — Developer & AI Context
text: model split two distinct layers strict boundary : Genetic component layer — managed define_trait(): - One row trait_meta per underlying genetic quantity (e.g. ADG_direct, ADG_social, WWD, WWM) - QTL effects genome_effects, TBVs ind_tbv, additive variance trait_var_comp - Arguments: target_add_var, target_add_mean, expressed_parent, description, units - phenotype-level information — mean, residual, type, expressed_sex Observation layer — managed define_phenotype(): - One row phenotype_meta per observed phenotype individuals receive records (e.g. ADG, WW, mortality) - simple traits, phenotype_name equals trait_name single genetic component - composite traits (maternal, SGE), phenotype_name new one trait_meta rows feed via phenotype_components - Arguments: type, mean, expressed_sex, repeatable, min_value, max_value, prevalence, thresholds, cat_values, cat_names, store_liability, residual_var, components, formula_tbv, formula, missing_component_action rule: argument describes genetics (variance, QTL structure, parent--origin), belongs define_trait(). describes observers record (mean, distribution, sex expression, residual noise, assemble components), belongs define_phenotype(). Never put observation-layer arguments define_trait() genetic-layer arguments define_phenotype().

title: tidybreed — Developer & AI Context
text: Per-chromosome copy counts, long format, keyed offspring sex. One row per (chr_name, offspring_sex, line_name). Created define_genome() one seeded default row per chromosome (from_parent_1 = from_parent_2 = 1, plain diploid autosome). define_chromosome() sets non-default rules (sex chromosomes, organelles). Answers: “offspring sex S inherits N copies chromosome parent.” Real polyploidy (ploidy > 2) yet supported — see ind_meta.ploidy. Logical key (chr_name, offspring_sex, line_name), NULL-normalized R. Counts absolute (correct ploidy 2, enforced): autosome 1,1; male’s X 0,1; male’s Y 1,0; female’s Y 0,0; maternal mito 0,1. Row-local CHECK/NULL constraints enforce offspring_sex ('M','F') (NULL passes), non-negative counts, from_parent_1 + from_parent_2 <= 2 (diploid-release constraint). from_parent_1/from_parent_2 map directly onto ind_haplotype.parent_origin (1 = sire, 2 = dam) strand.

title: tidybreed — Developer & AI Context
text: Per-chromosome recombination, long format, keyed producing-parent sex. One row per (chr_name, parent_sex, line_name). Seeded define_genome() genome-wide recombines_M/recombines_F defaults (one parent_sex = NULL row per chromosome agree, else 'M' 'F' row). define_chromosome() sets non-default rules (Y, W, achiasmy). Answers: “parent sex S makes gametes, chromosome recombine?” Logical key (chr_name, parent_sex, line_name), NULL-normalized R. two tables: “sex” means offspring copy count producing parent recombination — one table force one sex column mean . Splitting lets column say means (offspring_sex vs parent_sex), two concerns resolve independently (copy rule can never shadow recombination rule). Resolution. Two internal resolvers mirror resolve_genome_map()’s priority-window fallback (sex=S,line=L) → (sex=S,NULL) → (NULL,line=L) → (NULL,NULL): - resolve_chr_inheritance(conn, offspring_sex, line_name) — called offspring’s sex line; returns (from_parent_1, from_parent_2) per chr. - resolve_chr_recombination(conn, parent_sex, line_name) — called producing parent’s sex line; returns recombines per chr. validate_chr_inheritance()/validate_chr_recombination() run inside every write transaction: NULL-normalized key uniqueness, orphan-chr_name (R-enforced FK), valid sex, sum ≤ 2, resolvability M F, deterministic sex-vs-line shadowing check. chromosome takes fast autosome path resolved inheritance 1,1 offspring sexes recombines parent sexes. 2,0 (uniparental disomy) storage-expressible errors add_offspring()/add_founders() kernel boundary (unimplemented transmission mechanism).

title: tidybreed — Developer & AI Context
text: add_founders(), add_phenotype(), add_tbv(), add_ebv() accept ... optional custom columns written target table time new rows inserted. avoids redundant second mutate_table() step. Argument disambiguation: R’s standard matching routes explicit formal params (n_males, n_females, line_name, etc.) positions; anything else falls ... treated custom column. Reserved column names (id_ind, sex, line_name, etc.) blocked error. Type safety — column types inferred R value via infer_duckdb_type(). Use R’s type suffixes get right DuckDB type: Common pitfall: gen = 0 gives DOUBLE, INTEGER. Use gen = 0L. Pre-declaring column schema data exists (typed-NA workflow): shared internal helper prepare_extra_cols() R/sql_utils.R handles validation, type inference, ALTER TABLE, scalar broadcast add_* functions. Scalar vs. vector: - add_founders() / add_offspring(): scalars broadcast; vectors must length n_males + n_females (n_offspring). - add_phenotype() / add_tbv() / add_ebv(): scalar (row count per trait varies). Use mutate_table() afterwards per-record vectors.
code: # Single call — gen and farm written with the founders pop <- pop |>   add_founders(n_males = 10, n_females = 100, line_name = "A",                gen = 0L, farm = "Iowa")  # add_phenotype: scalar only (broadcast to all phenotype records) pop <- pop |>   get_table("ind_meta") |>   add_phenotype("ADG", test_env = "barn_A") # 1. After open_pop() |> define_genome(), declare column types on the empty table pop <- pop |>   get_table("ind_meta") |>   mutate_table(gen = NA_integer_, farm = NA_character_)  # 2. add_founders fills values in; types already match pop <- pop |>   add_founders(n_males = 10, n_females = 100, line_name = "A",                gen = 0L, farm = "Iowa")

title: tidybreed — Developer & AI Context
text: R/define_chromosome.R Sets non-default rule one chromosome — sex chromosomes (X/Y, Z/W, X0/Z0) organelles (MT, plastids). Call add_founders() chromosomes configures. call sets exactly one concern: supply from_parent_1 + from_parent_2 write chr_inheritance row (keyed offspring_sex), supply recombines write chr_recombination row (keyed parent_sex) — never one call (mixing make “sex” ambiguous). Writes transactional (delete--insert DISTINCT , validate, commit; rollback failure). overwrite = TRUE (default) upserts; overwrite = FALSE errors exact NULL-safe key already exists. add_founders() add_offspring() resolve chr_inheritance/ chr_recombination per chromosome: chromosome whose resolved inheritance 1,1 offspring sexes recombines parent sexes goes original, unchanged diploid path; chromosome routes separate branch writes applicable (sex, parent_origin) rows — non-recombining single-copy inheritance (Y, W, MT) — passes parent’s stored copy straight instead simulating crossover. Copy resolution uses offspring’s sex/line; recombination resolution uses producing parent’s sex/line. Real polyploidy (ploidy > 2, uneven-ploidy crosses) yet supported; ind_meta.ploidy must 2 every individual.
code: pop <- pop |>   # Mammal X/Y — inheritance (override only the deviating sexes)   define_chromosome("X", offspring_sex = "M", from_parent_1 = 0, from_parent_2 = 1) |>   define_chromosome("Y", offspring_sex = "M", from_parent_1 = 1, from_parent_2 = 0) |>   define_chromosome("Y", offspring_sex = "F", from_parent_1 = 0, from_parent_2 = 0) |>   define_chromosome("Y", recombines = FALSE)   # recombination (both parent sexes)

text: R/define_trait.R, R/define_additive_effects.R define_trait() — genetic layer . Writes one row trait_meta global (index_name = NULL, trait_name, economic_weight = 0) row index_meta. Accepted arguments: trait_name, target_add_var (writes trait_var_comp), target_add_mean, expressed_parent, description, units, overwrite. Never pass observation-layer arguments (type, mean, expressed_sex, residual_var, etc.) — belong define_phenotype(). overwrite = FALSE (default) errors trait already exists; overwrite = TRUE replaces trait_meta row index_meta entry. define_additive_effects() — accepts tidybreed_table get_table("genome_meta") (optionally filtered) first argument. trait_name accepts scalar vector trait names: Single trait — manual (effects vector) sampled (distribution = "normal"/"gamma") optional Falconer rescale. Reads target_add_var trait_var_comp. Multiple traits — draws correlated effects MVN(0, G) via MASS::mvrnorm. G = NULL reads trait_var_comp. method = "shared" (traits use filtered loci) "union" (per-trait QTL sets existing genome_effects rows, restricted filtered loci). Re-calling trait replaces existing rows genome_effects.
code: # Single trait pop |> get_table("genome_meta") |> filter(chr %in% 1:5) |> define_additive_effects("ADG")  # Multiple correlated traits (shared QTL set) G <- matrix(c(0.25, 0.10, 0.10, 0.30), 2, 2,             dimnames = list(c("ADG", "BW"), c("ADG", "BW"))) pop |> get_table("genome_meta") |> filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects(c("ADG", "BW"), G = G)  # Use generation-0 animals to define base allele frequencies gen0 <- get_table(pop, "ind_meta") |> filter(gen == 0L) pop |> get_table("genome_meta") |> filter(...) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", base = "current_pop", base_tbl = gen0)

title: Introduction to tidybreed
text: Founders sampled pool haplotypes. Tagging pool line_name good practice — lets run crossbreeding later. Several methods control allele-frequency spectrum linkage disequilibrium: argument belongs exactly one method — passing one wrong method error names belongs. two LD methods walk genetic map defined , resolved pool’s line_name. first four methods also take exact_freq. default draw frequency p per locus sample allele independent Bernoulli(p), realized pool frequency scatters around p. exact_freq = TRUE locus instead gets exactly round(p * n_haplotypes) copies 1-allele, independently drawn subset haplotypes — realized frequency p, still LD induced. defaults TRUE "fixed" (fixed frequency drifts fixed) FALSE elsewhere; turn want drift-free base frequency. One caveat worth knowing early: "mosaic", templates source variation, n_templates sets MAF spectrum, just block length. Roughly 2 / (n_templates + 1) loci come monomorphic matter many haplotypes ask , get warning past 10% — QTL landing contribute genetic variance. Raise n_templates, use "gaussian_copula", gives unquantized spectrum.

Re-running define_additive_effects() trait always overwrites rows genome_effects, recompute anything derived . realised variances neighbourhood 0.25 0.30 asked , exact — worth understanding rather glossing . target_add_var scales QTL effects additive variance comes right founder haplotype pool. animals actually created finite sample pool, realised variance wobbles around target. G <- matrix(   c(0.25, 0.08,     0.08, 0.30),   nrow = 2,   dimnames = list(c("ADG", "BF"), c("ADG", "BF")) )  pop <- pop |> define_effect_cov_matrix("gen_add", G) #> Stored 'gen_add' covariance matrix for: ADG, BF.  pop |> get_table("trait_var_comp") |> collect() #> # A tibble: 4 × 5 #>   id_trait_var_comp effect_name trait_name_1 trait_name_2 cov_value #>               <int> <chr>       <chr>        <chr>            <dbl> #> 1                 1 gen_add     ADG          ADG               0.25 #> 2                 2 gen_add     ADG          BF                0.08 #> 3                 3 gen_add     BF           ADG               0.08 #> 4                 4 gen_add     BF           BF                0.3 pop <- pop |>   get_table("genome_meta") |>   filter(chr %in% c(4L, 5L)) |>   define_additive_effects(c("ADG", "BF")) #> Set correlated additive effects for traits: ADG, BF (method: shared)  pop <- pop |>   define_phenotype("BF", type = "continuous", mean = 12, residual_var = 0.70) #> Added phenotype 'BF' (type: continuous). pop <- pop |> get_table("ind_meta") |> add_tbv()   # no trait_name = all traits #> Computed TBV for 500 individuals on trait 'ADG'. #> Computed TBV for 500 individuals on trait 'BF'.  pop |>   get_table("ind_tbv") |>   collect() |>   group_by(trait_name) |>   summarise(n = n(), mean_tbv = mean(tbv_value), var_tbv = var(tbv_value)) #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   trait_name     n mean_tbv var_tbv #>   <chr>      <int>    <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 ADG          500 -0.00520   0.220 #> 2 BF           500  0.00673   0.312

title: Tidy Breeding Program Simulation
text: Set package-wide options top script (startup / config script) simulations can parameterized without changing function calls throughout codebase. Every option built-default entirely optional — set ones need. Options prefixed tidybreed. read open_pop() (folder layout) archive_replicate() (multi-replicate archiving). tidybreed.pop_name — Label stored pop object (pop$pop_name); shown print(pop). Default: "sim". Purely descriptive — affect file paths. tidybreed.base_dir — Root folder (layer 1); default: getwd() tidybreed.output — Output subfolder name (layer 2); default: "tidybreed_output" tidybreed.scenario — Scenario subfolder (layer 3). Default NULL auto-generates YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS folder runs never overwrite . Set explicitly (e.g. "baseline") reuse folder, HPC array job. tidybreed.tools — Character vector tool subfolders created layer 4 (e.g. c("blupf90", "plink")). Default NULL skips tool folder creation. tidybreed.db_name — Working DuckDB file name; default: "sim.duckdb". Use ":memory:" -memory database (skips folder creation — useful tests). tidybreed.replicate — Integer replicate number stamped archive rows; default: 1L. Auto-increments successful archive_replicate() call. tidybreed.archive_path — Directory archive DuckDB file. Default NULL places archive next working database. tidybreed.db_name_archive — Archive DuckDB file name (e.g. "all_reps.duckdb"). Default NULL skips archiving entirely. tidybreed.quiet — Suppress startup banner library(tidybreed); default: FALSE. [!NOTE] Archive path resolution (archive_replicate()) — first non-NULL wins: Explicit archive_path argument passed archive_replicate(). file.path(tidybreed.archive_path, tidybreed.db_name_archive) — options set. file.path(dirname(pop$db_path), tidybreed.db_name_archive) — archive lands next working database. tidybreed.db_name_archive NULL — archive written; reset phases run.
code: options(   tidybreed.pop_name        = "my_project",   tidybreed.base_dir        = "~/path/to/project/",   tidybreed.output          = "tidybreed_output",   tidybreed.scenario        = "baseline_scenario",   tidybreed.tools           = c("blupf90", "plink", "JWAS"),   tidybreed.db_name         = "sim.duckdb",   tidybreed.replicate       = 1L,   tidybreed.archive_path    = "~/path/to/project/archive/",   tidybreed.db_name_archive = "baseline_scenario_all_reps.duckdb",   tidybreed.quiet           = FALSE )

title: Tidy Breeding Program Simulation
text: define_genome() single call builds genome. writes seven tables one transaction — genome_meta, genome_map, ind_haplotype, ind_genotype, ind_crossover, chr_inheritance, chr_recombination — rolls back anything fails, bad call leaves database exactly found pop can reused corrected call. Physical genetic coordinates live separate tables. genome_meta.pos_bp single physical source truth (BIGINT, 1-based, VCF/PLINK convention); pos_cM = pos_bp / 1e6 * cM_per_Mb written genome_map default map (sex = NULL, line_name = NULL, map_name = "default"). Sex- line-specific maps added later extra genome_map rows — rows, never schema change. Everything distance-driven (founder LD, recombination) reads resolved map, cM_per_Mb sets crossover rate: 50 Mb chromosome cM_per_Mb = 1.0 50 cM, .e. ~0.5 crossovers per meiosis. Optional arguments: [!IMPORTANT] define_genome() may called per population. errors seven genome tables already exists — partial re-definition. n_loci n_chr must whole numbers n_loci >= n_chr, chr_len_Mb / cM_per_Mb must finite strictly positive. checked anything written. Per-chromosome exceptions (sex chromosomes, organelles) set afterwards define_chromosome(), writes chr_inheritance rows (keyed offspring sex) chr_recombination rows (keyed producing-parent sex) — one concern per call.
code: pop <- pop |>   define_genome(     n_loci      = 10000,  # total number of loci (SNP + QTL)     n_chr       = 18,     # number of chromosomes     chr_len_Mb  = 50,     # physical length per chromosome, Mb (scalar or length n_chr)     cM_per_Mb   = 1.0     # genetic-map rate (scalar or length n_chr)   )  pop |> get_table("genome_meta")   # 1 row per locus — physical map (pos_bp) pop |> get_table("genome_map")    # 1 row per locus — genetic map (pos_cM)

title: Tidy Breeding Program Simulation
text: Generate haplotype pools genetic line. Six methods available: four draw per-locus allele frequency sample alleles independently (LD), two build LD along genetic map. method owns arguments, passing one wrong method hard error naming method belongs : four frequency-based methods also accept exact_freq. TRUE, locus gets exactly round(p × n_haplotypes) copies 1-allele independently drawn random subset haplotypes, realized pool frequency equals target binomial scatter (still LD — locus draws subset). FALSE, alleles independent Bernoulli(p) draws realized frequencies scatter around p sd sqrt(p(1-p)/n_haplotypes). exact_freq defaults TRUE method = "fixed" (“fixed” frequency drifts fixed) FALSE distribution-based methods, drawing frequency sampling binomially correct generative model. Set TRUE methods want drift-free base frequency. Frequencies live 1 / n_haplotypes grid; "fixed" -grid request warns names frequency actually used. LD methods read genetic map (genome_map) resolved pool’s line_name, founder LD built map later drives recombination line. [!TIP] "mosaic", n_templates controls MAF spectrum, just block length. Templates source allelic variation, locus templates agree monomorphic regardless n_haplotypes — roughly 2 / (n_templates + 1) loci, MAF quantized multiples 1 / n_templates. warning fires 10% loci come monomorphic, QTL placed contribute nothing sum(2pq ²). Raise n_templates, use "gaussian_copula" dense, unquantized MAF spectrum. Note also template re-draw uniform templates including current one (standard Li-Stephens kernel — makes realized LD invariant marker density), observable template changes occur template_switch_rate × (n_templates − 1) / n_templates. Calling line_name = NULL (default) stores one shared pool add_founders() falls back named pool exists line building. Calling line_name already pool — NULL NULL-line pool exists — error. Every call also writes founder_allele_freq column genome_meta holding per-locus frequency pool written recently. code: options(tidybreed.replicate = 1L) options(tidybreed.db_name_archive = "scenario_1_all_reps.duckdb")  pop <- open_pop(...) |> define_genome(...) |>   define_trait(...) |> define_phenotype(...)  for (i in seq_len(100)) {   pop <- pop |>     get_table("founder_haplotypes") |>     add_founders(n_males = 10, n_females = 90, line_name = "A") |>     get_table("ind_meta") |>     add_phenotype("ADG") |>     archive_replicate() }  # post-hoc analysis. When only 'tidybreed.db_name_archive' is set (as # above), the archive file is written next to the working DB, which may # itself be nested under open_pop()'s layer-2/3 folders (see ?open_pop) — # so resolve the path from the pop object rather than assuming a bare # filename in the current working directory. archive_path <- file.path(dirname(pop$db_path), "scenario_1_all_reps.duckdb") archive <- restore_pop(archive_path) get_table(archive, "ind_phenotype") |>   dplyr::filter(replicate == 5L) |>   dplyr::collect() rep_id <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID")) options(tidybreed.replicate = rep_id) options(tidybreed.db_name_archive = paste0("scenario_1_rep_", rep_id, ".duckdb")) pop <- open_pop(...) |> ... |> archive_replicate()

title: Define additive QTL effects for one or more traits — define_additive_effects
text: Selects QTL filtered genome_meta table writes additive effects genome_effects table. Single trait (trait_name length 1) — two modes: Manual: pass effects, numeric vector length n_qtl (number filtered loci) ascending locus_id order. Sampled: draw effects distribution ("normal" "gamma"). scale_to_target = TRUE, effects rescaled using Falconer formula expected additive variance base population equals target_add_var stored trait. Multiple traits (trait_name length >= 2) — effects drawn jointly multivariate normal distribution keyed additive-genetic covariance matrix G. Two locus-selection methods: method = "shared" — loci tbl become shared QTL set traits. Loci QTL subset traits genome_effects also receive independent draws (diagonal variance G trait). method = "union" — loci tbl form candidate pool; per-trait membership determined existing rows genome_effects. base argument controls allele frequencies used: "founder_haplotypes" (default) — computes allele frequencies directly founder_haplotypes table (requires define_founder_haplotypes() called). Restrict one founder pool base_line_name. (read genome_meta.founder_allele_freq, informational .) "current_pop" — computes allele frequencies current ind_haplotype table. Pass filtered tidybreed_table via base_tbl restrict individuals define base population.

title: Define additive QTL effects for one or more traits — define_additive_effects
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Single trait — all loci on chr 1-5 become QTL; scale to target variance pop <- pop |>   define_trait("ADG", target_add_var = 0.25) |>   get_table("genome_meta") |>   dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", distribution = "normal")  # Multiple correlated traits — shared QTL set, joint MVN draw G <- matrix(c(0.25, 0.10, 0.10, 0.30), 2, 2,             dimnames = list(c("ADG", "BW"), c("ADG", "BW"))) pop <- pop |>   define_effect_cov_matrix("gen_add", G) |>   get_table("genome_meta") |>   dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects(c("ADG", "BW"), G = G)  # current_pop: use generation-0 individuals to define base allele frequencies gen0_tbl <- get_table(pop, "ind_meta") |> dplyr::filter(gen == 0L) pop <- pop |>   get_table("genome_meta") |>   dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", base = "current_pop", base_tbl = gen0_tbl)  # Crossbreeding: each line's effects centered on its own founder pool. # base_line_name inherits line_name, so nothing extra is needed. pop <- pop |>   get_table("genome_meta") |> dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", line_name = "Duroc") pop <- pop |>   get_table("genome_meta") |> dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", line_name = "Landrace")  # Line-specific effects, but deliberately centered on the pooled base pop <- pop |>   get_table("genome_meta") |> dplyr::filter(chr %in% 1:5) |>   define_additive_effects("ADG", line_name = "Duroc", base_line_name = NULL) } # }

what: Define a chromosome's inheritance or recombination rule — define_chromosome
title: Define a chromosome's inheritance or recombination rule — define_chromosome
text: Sets non-default rule one chromosome — sex chromosomes (X/Y, Z/W, X0/Z0) organelles (mitochondria, plastids). define_genome() seeds every chromosome default diploid-autosome rule (one copy parent, recombining sexes); call define_chromosome() add_founders() override default. rule stored across two explicit long tables, call sets exactly one concern: Inheritance (copy count): supply from_parent_1 from_parent_2 — number copies chromosome offspring offspring_sex inherits parent_1 (sire) parent_2 (dam). Writes chr_inheritance. Recombination: supply recombines — whether parent parent_sex recombines chromosome making gametes. Writes chr_recombination. Copy counts absolute (correct ploidy 2, version enforces): autosome from_parent_1 = 1, from_parent_2 = 1; male's X 0, 1; male's Y 1, 0; female's Y 0, 0; maternal mitochondria 0, 1. two concerns kept separate calls "sex" means offspring copy count producing parent recombination — mixing one call make ambiguous.

text: Single entry point storing variance covariance data tidybreed. Routes trait_var_comp genetic effects phenotype_var_comp phenotype-level effects. Common effect_name values: "gen_add" — additive genetic (co)variances (G matrix). Written trait_var_comp. Used define_additive_effects() rescaling target variance sampling distribution multi-trait draws. "dominance", "epistasis" — future genetic effects. Written trait_var_comp. Row/column names trait names. "residual" — residual (co)variances (R matrix). Routed phenotype_var_comp effect_name = "residual". Row/column names phenotype names. Equivalent calling define_residual_cov() condition_column = NULL. Use multi-phenotype correlated residual matrix; single scalar residual use residual_var define_phenotype() instead. named random effect ("hys", "litter", "pen", …) — written phenotype_var_comp. Must match effect_name used define_effect_random(). Row/column names phenotype names. define_effect_cov_matrix() can called define_trait() define_effect_random() — prior setup required. n² pairs stored. Previous entries effect_name × names combination replaced.

title: Define founder haplotypes for a tidybreed population — define_founder_haplotypes
text: pop tidybreed_pop object returned define_genome(). n_haplotypes Positive integer. Number founder haplotypes generate. method Character scalar. One "uniform" (default), "fixed", "beta", "balding_nichols", "mosaic", "gaussian_copula". Passing argument belongs different method raises error. allele_freq (method = "fixed" ) Numeric scalar [0, 1]. Allele frequency realized exactly every locus. Default 0.5. Frequencies live 1 / n_haplotypes grid; allele_freq × n_haplotypes whole number rounded, warning naming frequency actually used. min_allele_freq (method = "uniform" ) Lower bound. Default 0.01. max_allele_freq (method = "uniform" ) Upper bound. Default 0.99. beta_shape1 (method = "beta" ) First Beta shape parameter (α). Must finite > 0. Default 0.5. beta_shape2 (method = "beta" ) Second Beta shape parameter (β). Must finite > 0. Default 0.5. fst (method = "balding_nichols" ) Wright's F_ST. Scalar (0, 1). Controls spread frequencies around mean_allele_freq; larger values produce extreme frequencies. Default 0.1. mean_allele_freq (method = "balding_nichols" ) Ancestral mean allele frequency. Scalar (0, 1). Default 0.5. n_templates (method = "mosaic" ) Number template haplotypes. Must whole number [2, n_haplotypes]. Also controls MAF spectrum — see "mosaic" entry . Default max(20, ceiling(sqrt(n_haplotypes))), clamped n_haplotypes. floor 20 keeps expected monomorphic fraction near 10%; lower deliberately want long, coarse LD blocks. template_switch_rate (method = "mosaic" ) Template re-draw rate per cM (genetic distance). Higher values create shorter LD blocks. 0 means never switch (complete LD within chromosome). Note observable template changes occur template_switch_rate × (n_templates − 1) / n_templates — see "mosaic" entry . Default 1.0. (default cM_per_Mb = 1, per-cM equals per-Mb.) ld_decay_rate (method = "gaussian_copula" ) LD decay rate λ ρ = exp(−λ × d_cM). Higher values → faster LD decay. 0 means decay (complete LD within chromosome). Default 1.0 gives ρ ≈ 0.37 1 cM. exact_freq (methods "fixed", "uniform", "beta", "balding_nichols") Logical. TRUE, locus receives exactly round(p × n_haplotypes) copies 1-allele independently drawn random subset haplotypes, realized pool frequency equals per-locus target p binomial fluctuation (LD induced — locus draws subset). FALSE, alleles drawn independent Bernoulli(p) trials, realized frequencies scatter around p sd sqrt(p(1-p)/n_haplotypes). Defaults TRUE method = "fixed" ("fixed" frequency drifts fixed) FALSE distribution-based methods, drawing frequency sampling alleles binomially correct generative model. Set TRUE methods want founder_allele_freq exact base frequency Falconer centering. Frequencies snapped 1 / n_haplotypes grid; method = "fixed" warning names frequency actually used requested one -grid (distribution methods continuous draw essentially never grid, rounding silent). line_name Optional character scalar. label haplotype pool (e.g. "LineA"). Must start letter contain letters, numbers, underscores. supplied, founder_haplotypes rows tagged label (haplotype_id sequential within pool). add_founders() line_name sample exclusively rows. NULL (default), rows stored line_name = NA add_founders() falls back named pool exists requested line.

title: Define founder haplotypes for a tidybreed population — define_founder_haplotypes
text: "uniform" (default) Per-locus allele frequency sampled Uniform(min_allele_freq, max_allele_freq). LD structure. "fixed" Every locus gets allele_freq (default 0.5), exactly. Rather drawing allele Bernoulli(allele_freq) trial — leaves realized pool frequency fluctuating binomially around target — exactly round(allele_freq × n_haplotypes) haplotypes carry 1-allele locus, independently drawn random subset per locus (LD induced). LD structure. "beta" Per-locus allele frequency sampled Beta(beta_shape1, beta_shape2). Default shape1 = shape2 = 0.5 (Jeffreys prior) gives U-shaped MAF distribution many rare common alleles — biologically realistic. LD structure. "balding_nichols" Balding-Nichols model: per-locus frequency Beta(α, β) α = mean_allele_freq × (1 − fst) / fst β = (1 − mean_allele_freq) × (1 − fst) / fst. Models allele frequency drift around mean. LD structure. "mosaic" Quick LD via haplotype block copying. Generates n_templates template haplotypes, builds new haplotype mosaic: copies template re-draws template probability 1 - exp(-template_switch_rate × d_cM) locus. Creates realistic LD blocks without external software. Uses genetic map (genome_map) resolved pool's line_name adjacent-locus distances. Performance O(n_haplotypes × n_loci); use "gaussian_copula" large simulations. Two properties model easy miss. First, re-draw uniform templates including current one, rate observable template changes template_switch_rate × (n_templates − 1) / n_templates. deliberate — standard Li-Stephens copying kernel, makes realized LD invariant marker density. Second, templates source allelic variation, locus n_templates templates agree monomorphic regardless n_haplotypes; roughly 2 / (n_templates + 1) loci monomorphic, MAF spectrum quantized multiples 1 / n_templates. Raise n_templates need rare variants dense MAF spectrum. "gaussian_copula" Fast LD via AR(1) latent normal. latent Gaussian AR(1) process runs along chromosome; adjacent-locus correlation decays ρ = exp(−ld_decay_rate × d_cM). Haplotypes generated thresholding latent values locus's target allele frequency. Fully vectorised haplotypes, unlike "mosaic" produces unquantized MAF spectrum. Uses genetic map (genome_map) resolved pool's line_name.

title: Define founder haplotypes for a tidybreed population — define_founder_haplotypes
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Each method demo below starts from a fresh pop — define_founder_haplotypes() # errors if called again with line_name = NULL once a NULL-line pool already # exists, so these are alternative choices, not a sequential recipe. new_pop <- function() {   open_pop(pop_name = "A", db_name = ":memory:") |>     define_genome(n_loci = 1000, n_chr = 10, chr_len_Mb = 100) }  # Uniform allele frequencies (default) pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200)  # Fixed allele frequency of 0.5 pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200, method = "fixed")  # Beta(0.5, 0.5) — biologically realistic MAF distribution pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200, method = "beta")  # Balding-Nichols with FST = 0.05 pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200,                                  method = "balding_nichols", fst = 0.05)  # Beta frequencies, realized exactly (no binomial scatter around the draw) pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200,                                  method = "beta", exact_freq = TRUE)  # Quick LD via mosaic block copying pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200, method = "mosaic")  # Fast LD via Gaussian copula AR(1) pop <- new_pop() |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200,                                  method = "gaussian_copula", ld_decay_rate = 0.5)  # Two lines with different LD structures (same pop, distinct line_name) pop <- new_pop() pop <- pop |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200, line_name = "A",                                  method = "mosaic") pop <- pop |> define_founder_haplotypes(n_haplotypes = 200, line_name = "B",                                  method = "gaussian_copula", ld_decay_rate = 0.5) } # }

text: pop tidybreed_pop object open_pop(). Must already genome defined — define_genome() called per population. n_loci Integer scalar. Total number loci simulate. Must whole number least n_chr (every chromosome needs locus). n_chr Integer scalar. Number chromosomes. Must whole number. chr_len_Mb Numeric scalar numeric vector length n_chr. Chromosome length(s) megabases. single scalar applies length chromosomes; vector specifies chromosome separately. Determines physical coordinate genome_meta.pos_bp. cM_per_Mb Numeric scalar numeric vector length n_chr. Genetic map rate centiMorgans per megabase, used derive genetic map position genome_map.pos_cM pos_bp (pos_cM = pos_bp/1e6 * cM_per_Mb). Default 1.0. Must finite strictly positive. locus_names Character vector length n_loci NULL. Custom locus names. NULL (default), names auto-generated "Locus_1", "Locus_2", etc. chr_names Character vector length n_chr NULL. Custom chromosome names. NULL (default), chromosomes numbered 1, 2, ..., n_chr. recombines_M, recombines_F Logical scalar. Genome-wide recombination default male-parent female-parent meiosis, seeded chr_recombination. default TRUE. Set one FALSE genome-wide, whole-genome achiasmatic sex (e.g. recombines_F = FALSE silkworm females, recombines_M = FALSE Drosophila males) instead writing per-chromosome rule every chromosome. Per-chromosome overrides (Y, W, Drosophila chr4) still go define_chromosome().

title: Define an observed phenotype — define_phenotype
text: pop tidybreed_pop object. phenotype_name Character. Name observed phenotype; equals trait_name simple (non-composite) traits. type Character. One "continuous", "count", "categorical", "derived_formula". "derived_formula" phenotypes computed add_phenotype() time evaluating formula expression already- recorded phenotype values individuals; TBV, residual variance, QTL . mean Numeric. Phenotypic population mean (intercept). Default 0. expressed_sex Character. receives phenotype record: "" (default), "M", "F". repeatable Logical. Whether individual can multiple records phenotype (e.g. repeated test-day litter-size records). Default FALSE. min_value, max_value Numeric. Clipping bounds count traits. NULL means limit. prevalence Numeric 0 1. categorical traits one threshold (two categories), fraction expected threshold. Mutually exclusive thresholds. thresholds Numeric vector length K−1 K ordered categories. Liability cutpoints ascending order. Mutually exclusive prevalence. cat_values Numeric vector length K. Phenotype value stored ind_phenotype category. Defaults 1, 2, ..., K. cat_names Character vector length K. Human-readable label per category, e.g. c("Alive", "Dead"). Must contain commas. store_liability Logical. TRUE, underlying liability value written reserved liability_value column ind_phenotype. meaningful categorical traits. residual_var Numeric. Scalar residual variance. supplied, writes one unconditional row phenotype_var_comp (effect_name = "residual", condition_column = NULL). heterogeneous residuals multi-phenotype correlated residuals, use define_residual_cov() afterwards. components data frame tibble one row per genetic component. Columns: source_trait_name (required): component trait name trait_meta. contributor_type (required): "self", "dam", "sire", "group". weight (optional, default 1.0): scalar multiplier. weight_type (optional, default "fixed"): "fixed", "covariate", "legendre", "raw_poly". covariate_name (optional): covariate key. covariate_table (optional): table containing covariate column; NULL means value supplied add_phenotype() call time. poly_order (optional): polynomial basis order. poly_scale_min, poly_scale_max (optional): Legendre scaling bounds. genome_effect_types (optional, default "additive"). group_column (optional): column defining group membership. group_table (optional, default "ind_meta"): table containing group_column. aggregation (optional, default "sum"): "sum" "mean" group contributors. missing_action (optional, default "skip"): currently unused per-component override — behaviour governed uniformly missing_component_action . contributor_filter (optional): reserved future spatial/ neighborhood contributor lookup; yet implemented. NULL (default) → simple single-self trait; phenotype_components written. Mutually exclusive formula_tbv. formula_tbv Character. DSL shorthand assembling composite TBV component traits already trait_meta. bare trait symbol (e.g. "WWD") means individual's ("self") TBV; contributor roles can also given explicitly function calls: self(trait), dam(trait), sire(trait), group_sum(trait, col), group_mean(trait, col) (col = grouping column ind_meta, e.g. pen litter). combined arithmetic operators +, -, *, /, parentheses (e.g. "WWD + dam(WWM)", "ADG_direct + group_sum(ADG_social, pen_id)"). Mutually exclusive components. valid type = "derived_formula". formula Character. Arithmetic expression evaluated already- recorded phenotype values produce derived phenotype (e.g. "ADFI / ADG" feed conversion ratio). Phenotype names reference ind_phenotype records (pheno_number = 1) produced earlier add_phenotype() call — component phenotypes must already recorded, add_phenotype() topologically sorts multiple derived_formula phenotypes dependencies computed first. Operators +, -, *, /, ^ parentheses supported, plus math functions sqrt, log, log2, log10, exp, abs, round, ceiling, floor, sign, trunc, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan. Non-finite results (Inf/NaN) converted NA warning. Required type = "derived_formula". valid otherwise. missing_component_action Character. individual missing one required composite-TBV components (e.g. group assignment "group" contributor, missing dam/sire TBV). "skip" (default) excludes individual ind_phenotype emits warning count. "error" stops informative message listing affected individuals. Stored phenotype_meta behaviour consistent across add_phenotype() calls phenotype. Note: unrelated null_class_action (set via define_effect_fixed_class()), handles NULL levels fixed-class covariate effects, affect random-effect draws (new levels always get fresh draw). overwrite Logical. TRUE phenotype name already exists, replace rows phenotype_meta phenotype_components. Default FALSE errors duplicate.

what: Genome position coordinates & genetic map (breaking schema change)
title: tidybreed 0.50.0 (2026-07-06)
text: Physical genetic map positions now stored separately, matching genome_effects precedent (sex/line/version dimensions become rows, never schema change). Pre-1.0.0: breaking changes ship MINOR bump. genome_meta: pos_Mb DOUBLE → pos_bp BIGINT (physical position, base pairs, 1-based; VCF/PLINK convention, lossless export). pos_bp created via explicit typed CREATE TABLE, user row-adds integer pos_bp widen BIGINT automatically — R-side conversion, type survives mutate_table()/define_chip()/restore_pop(). New genome_map table holds genetic map (pos_cM DOUBLE), keyed (locus_id, sex, line_name, map_name); sex/line_name NULL = applies sexes / lines; map_name defaults "default". define_genome() writes single default map; sex/line/version-specific maps added rows. define_genome(cM_per_Mb = 1.0) — new argument (scalar length-n_chr, strictly positive) deriving pos_cM = pos_bp/1e6 * cM_per_Mb. Recombination founder-LD now driven genetic distance (cM), physical Mb. chr_meta.recombines → recombines_M + recombines_F (per-sex, matching copy_mode_M/copy_mode_F). define_chr(recombines = ...) remains primary shorthand sets ; pass recombines_M/recombines_F single-sex achiasmy (e.g. Drosophila males). Removed genome_meta.introduced_gen (unused Stage-5 scaffolding). New internal helpers resolve_genome_map() (per-gamete sex/line map resolution monotonicity + completeness validation) validate_genome_map(). Founder-LD helpers recombination readers now key resolved map; founder_allele_freq write longer rewrites genome_meta (preserves BIGINT type via ALTER TABLE + UPDATE). Reproducibility forward-(seed reproduces current code); old seeded output preserved.

what: New features — sex chromosomes and organelles (Stage 4)
title: tidybreed 0.49.0 (2026-07-03)
text: chr_meta/define_chr() now support non-diploid inheritance rules: sex chromosomes (X/Y, Z/W, X0/Z0) organelles (mitochondria, plastids). Real polyploidy (ploidy > 2, uneven-ploidy crosses) remains scope — ind_meta.ploidy column added forward schema compatibility, every individual must ploidy = 2 version. Schema: chr_meta.copies_M/copies_F (absolute integers) renamed copy_mode_M/copy_mode_F ("full"/"half"/"none", relative individual’s ploidy) — resolves terminology clash flagged Stage 4 planning. New ind_meta.ploidy column (UTINYINT, default 2, reserved). New define_chr() (R/define_chr.R) — upserts chromosome’s inheritance rule (copy_mode_M, copy_mode_F, hemi_parent, recombines) chr_meta, validation enum values hemi_parent/copy_mode consistency requirement. add_founders() gains ploidy argument (must 2) now writes ind_haplotype rows per chromosome according chr_meta: parent_origin slots "full", hemi_parent-designated slot "half", none "none". founder haplotype-pool sampling draw unchanged (still one flat sample() call), preserving byte-exact parity existing diploid-autosome simulations. add_offspring() now branches per chromosome: plain autosomes go original, unchanged recombination path; sex-linked/organelle chromosomes route new branch resolves contributing parent’s copy count, recombines parent carries 2 copies (via make_gamete(), scoped one chromosome), otherwise passes parent’s single stored copy straight via new pass_through_gamete() helper (R/recombination_helpers.R) consumes zero RNG draws one copy exists — strictly hemizygous, non-recombining inheritance (patrilineal Y, matrilineal MT) never perturbs random stream. add_dosage()/extract_genotypes(): Stage 3 assert_diploid_only() guard (blocked non-default chr_meta row) replaced assert_ploidy_2() (R/ploidy_helpers.R), scoped ind_meta.ploidy instead — underlying SUM(allele) SQL already correct row count per locus, sex-linked/organelle chromosomes now work SQL changes, guard needed relaxing. add_tbv() required changes — centered SQL already sums however many haplotype rows exist per individual per locus. define_additive_effects(scale_to_target = TRUE) now errors clearly selected QTL locus non-"full"-copy_mode chromosome, since Falconer variance formula (2*p*(1-p)*^2) assumes diploid/autosomal loci otherwise silently miscalibrate trait variance sex-linked QTL. Parity preserved: tests/testthat/test-parity.R’s golden files unchanged (re-baseline) — confirms diploid-autosome case byte-identical stage’s restructuring. New tests: test-define_chr.R, test-sex_chromosomes.R (X/Y, Z/W, MT, X0, mixed autosome+sex-chromosome dosage/export), extended test-ploidy_helpers.R, test-add_tbv.R, test-define_additive_effects.R.

title: tidybreed 0.48.0 (2026-07-02)
text: add_tbv() now uses line_origin (populated every allele since Stage 1) compute correct crossbreeding additive TBV. Centering now folded per-allele summed SQL term ((allele - base_allele_freq) * genome_value), reproduces prior Falconer-centered result exactly population-wide effects exist (behavior change existing population-wide-simulations — verified via Stage 1 parity harness). Imprinted traits (expressed_parent = "parent_1"/"parent_2") combine correctly line-specific effects: query still restricts expressed parent’s parent_origin. Internal-get_genotype_matrix()/get_haplotype_matrix() helpers, superseded new SQL, removed.

Accepts pop, n_loci, n_chr, chr_len_Mb, locus_names, chr_names. pop$run_dirs — named character vector every tidybreed_pop object mapping tool names pre-created layer-4 output directories. Always includes "base" entry pointing layer-3 scenario directory. character(0) -memory databases. .create_run_dir(pop, tool) (internal) — creates timestamped YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_rrrrrr run subdirectory inside pop$run_dirs[[tool]]. text: define_founder_haplotypes() now supports six methods via method argument: "uniform" (default) — per-locus freq Uniform(min, max); replaces allele_freq_dist = "uniform" "fixed" — every locus gets allele_freq (default 0.5); replaces fixed_allele_freq "beta" — per-locus freq Beta(beta_shape1, beta_shape2); default shape1 = shape2 = 0.5 (Jeffreys prior, biologically realistic MAF distribution) "balding_nichols" — Beta parameterised Wright’s fst mean_freq; models allele frequency drift around mean "mosaic" — quick LD via haplotype block copying: n_templates template haplotypes generated new haplotypes mosaics switch templates rate switch_rate per Mb; external software required "gaussian_copula" — fast LD via AR(1) latent normal thresholding; fully vectorised haplotypes; inter-locus correlation decays ρ = exp(−decay_rate × d_Mb) Passing method-specific argument wrong method now raises informative error naming argument method belongs . LD methods ("mosaic", "gaussian_copula"), genome_meta$founder_allele_freq stores empirical column means generated haplotype matrix rather input parameters.

title: tidybreed 0.2.0 (2026-04-20)
text: add_trait() — insert row trait_meta target variance components, trait type (continuous / count / binary / categorical), expression rules (sex-limited, parent--origin), index/economic weights. Creates six trait-layer tables first call. define_qtl() — mirror define_chip() QTL loci; writes is_QTL_{trait} BOOLEAN column genome_meta. Reuses six selection methods (count + random / even / chromosome_even, logical vector, locus ids, locus names). set_qtl_effects() — write add_{trait} additive-effect column. Supports manual effects sampled effects (normal / gamma) automatic rescaling hit trait_meta$target_add_var. set_qtl_effects_multi() — draw correlated additive effects across multiple traits MVN(0, G) via MASS::mvrnorm; supports "shared" (pleiotropy) "union" strategies. set_residual_cov() — store residual covariance matrix R across traits new trait_residual_cov table. Consumed add_phenotype() multiple traits share filtered subset. add_trait_covariate() — append fixed random covariate rows trait_effects table. Fixed-effect levels serialised JSON-style VARCHAR; random effects store distribution + variance. add_phenotype() — workhorse. Generates phenotypes subset individuals one traits writes rows ind_phenotype. Also computes stores underlying TBV ind_tbv. Joint MVN residual draws multiple traits share subset R stored. add_tbv() — compute store TBV without generating phenotype records. add_ebv() — ingest externally computed estimated breeding values ind_ebv, tagged user-supplied model label. add_trait_simple() — one-shot wrapper chaining add_trait() + define_qtl() + set_qtl_effects().
